Three months after Europe, 6 of Villa's starting XI are already gone

Aston Villa won the Europa League and finished fourth in the Premier League in 2025/26. Yet by September, six of the eleven players who started the Europa League final had left. League form has started slowly at four points from five matches, while Villa won their Champions League opener away. 今のヴィラを理解する鍵は、Emery's tactical operating system has survived, but many of the human connections inside it have not.
